entry.note: Quiet morning, chai on the balcony before work.
آج صبح کی سیر بہت اچھی رہی، دل ہلکا ہو گیا۔
Called my sister. We planned the trip north for March.
Aaj office mein kaam bohat tha, lunch bhi late kiya.
Cooked dinner with Amna. The daal came out right for once.
Neend nahi aayi, shaam ko chai zyada pi li thi.
Finished the quarterly report early and walked home through the park.
میٹنگ لمبی ہو گئی اور دوپہر کا کھانا رہ گیا۔
Abbu ke saath bazaar gaya, unhone naye jootay dilaye.
Bad day. Missed the bus, spilled tea on my notes, and the printer jammed twice.
Slow start. Answered emails until ten.
ماں کے ہاتھ کی کھچڑی کھائی، بچپن یاد آ گیا۔
Ghar ki yaad aa rahi thi, phone par ammi se baat ki.
Long walk after Maghrib. Legs sore but the head is clear.
